title: The Bernoulli Model: A Probabilistic Framework for Data Structures and Types
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapters 1, 2, 3, 4 and 13. An overview of the Bernoulli model of approximate data types: values observed through binary channels with false-positive and false-negative rates, trading space for accuracy. Credits probability-typed approximate computing (Decaf, Rely, Uncertain<T>).
